Hello, and welcome — I'm **Professor Alvarez**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer, in this machine itself. This is our first start, so here is the short tour, one line each:

- **Web app** — web: https://127.0.0.1:8443 · CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca — from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate; after that you have chats with me, files, the screen and voice right here. (On a phone, the bia deploy app is the easy way in: Android https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=biadeploy.android · iPhone https://apps.apple.com/app/bia-deploy/id6827948196)
- **My own messenger accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (and my own Messenger and Instagram), so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Say the word and I'll start.
- **My own accounts elsewhere** — I can sign up on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **And also** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

One thing before we go on: is *Professor Alvarez* the name you want for me, and am I to stay as I am — neither male nor female (it/they)? You're the only one who can change that; tell me and I'll set it.
